# Google

11 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit), 5 advanced (5), 2 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/google/ad - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns detailed information about a specific Google advertisement including ad copy, advertiser, and format.

**Use when** Use it after company/ads to expand a single creative, since the list version does not carry the ad's own copy. No impression estimate is returned.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Ads Transparency Center CREATIVE URL: must include both the advertiser and creative segments (`…/advertiser/{AR…}/creative/{CR…}`). Get one from `/v1/google/company/ads`. · e.g. `https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR01614014350098432001/creative/CR10449491775734153217`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+8 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/ad" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR01614014350098432001/creative/CR10449491775734153217" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google/adlibrary/advertisers/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Searches the Google Ads Transparency Center for advertisers matching a query. Returns matching advertisers with `name`, `advertiser_id`, and `region`, plus their website domains. Defaults to US when `region` is omitted: pass a 2-letter country code (e.g. `AU`, `CA`) to search advertisers in another region.

**Use when** Use it first to look up the advertiser_id that company/ads needs when all you have is a brand name.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword or phrase to find advertisers in the Google Ads Transparency Center. · e.g. `lululemon`
- `region` (optional, string) - 2-letter country code to search in. Defaults to US.

**Response** `AuthorList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ author }` ([full schema](schemas/AuthorList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.location` | ISO region code… |

Never filled: `author.avatar_url`, `author.bio`, `author.followers`, `author.following`, `author.joined_at`, `author.likes_count`, `author.posts_count`, `author.url`, `author.username`, `author.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/adlibrary/advertisers/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=lululemon" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google/business/extended-reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns reviews of a place aggregated from the Google reviews element, not only Google users but reputable third-party sources (TripAdvisor, Yelp, Trustpilot). Each review carries its source domain, full text (with original-language translation), star rating, reviewer stats, and owner replies. Identify the place by keyword, cid, or place_id.

**Use when** you want a place's reviews from Google and third party sites together, rather than product or app reviews.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 600 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** single page - Depth-based fan-out: page size is controlled by depth, one call.

**Query params**

- `keyword` (optional, string) - Business name + address. Use cid/place_id for an exact match. · e.g. `Irving Farm New York 645 5th Ave`
- `cid` (optional, string) - Google customer id (cid) of the place.
- `place_id` (optional, string) - Google place_id of the place.
- `location_name` (optional, string) - Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.
- `language_name` (optional, string) - Result language (default 'English').
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of reviews to return (default 20, step 20, max 1000).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `keyword`, `cid`, `place_id`.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |
| `review.responses` | Owner/brand/management replies to the review, each `{id… |

+16 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `review.author.location`, `review.helpful_votes`, `review.language`, `review.title`, `review.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/business/extended-reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "keyword=Irving Farm New York 645 5th Ave" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google/company/ads - 5 credits (advanced)

**Use when** you want to page through an advertiser's whole ad history by domain or advertiser_id, filtered by date, placement, or format.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈40/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/40) x 5 credits

- `get_ad_details` (optional, string) - Set to true to get the ad details. Will cost 25 credits.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor to paginate through results

**Constraints**

## GET /v1/google/keyword-volume - 16 credits (custom)

Returns Google monthly search volume, cost per click, competition, and a 12-month trend for up to 20 keywords in one country. Response is `{ location, location_name, language, items }`: each item carries `keyword`, `search_volume` (average monthly searches), `cpc` with its `currency`, `competition` (0 to 1) with `competition_level`, `monthly_searches` (the last 12 months, oldest first, as `{ year, month, search_volume }`) and, where Google classifies it, `search_intent`. Use it to compare demand for a product across markets: call it once per country with the same keywords. You get one item per keyword you asked for, in your order. A keyword Google holds no volume for comes back with `search_volume: null`, never 0, so a null means unknown and a 0 means Google reports none. When no keyword has any data the call returns 404 and costs 0 credits. Volumes are Google's own rounded monthly averages and are refreshed monthly, so results are cached for 24 hours. Typical latency is 2 seconds. Priced at a flat 16 credits per call whatever the keyword count, so send all 20 at once.

**Use when** you want to compare demand for a product across countries by calling it once per country with the same keywords.
**Cost** cache 86400 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `keywords` (required) - 1-20 comma-separated keywords (e.g. 'lip gloss,lip oil'). Each keyword may be up to 80 characters. Duplicates are ignored. More than 20 keywords, or a keyword over 80 characters, is rejected with a free 400 before the request is billed. · e.g. `lip gloss,lip oil`
- `location` (optional, string) - Country as an ISO code ('US', 'GB', 'KR'), a full country name ('United Kingdom', 'South Korea') or a numeric location code ('2826'). Defaults to the United States. Volume is published for 94 countries; any other location is rejected with a free 400 naming the accepted forms. · e.g. `GB`
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code ('en', 'de', 'ko') the keywords are searched in. Defaults to the country's primary language, so Germany is 'de' and Belgium is 'fr'. A language the country does not hold (Germany in English) is rejected with a free 400 listing the ones it does.

**Constraints**

- `keywords`: at most 20 comma-separated values.

**Response** `Analytics`. Fields not published yet - call it once; `/v1/utility/endpoint?id=google/keyword-volume` serves the current contract.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/keyword-volume" \
  --data-urlencode "keywords=lip gloss,lip oil" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Google search results for a query. Each result includes title, URL, and a text snippet.

**Use when** you want it for general web results; for Korean web pages use naver/webkr/search, and for news headlines use google_news/search.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈10/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword or phrase · e.g. `best restaurants in London`
- `region` (optional, string) - 2 letter country code, ie US, UK, CA, etc This will show results from that country
- `date_posted` (optional, enum: last-hour | last-day | last-week | last-month | last-year) - Date posted
- `page` (optional, integer) - Page number to retrieve

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ description, title, url }` (inferred from a sample): `description`, `title`, `url`.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best restaurants in London" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
